genotype.note: Markers of Xenopus laevis cell types. A xenobot has the donor's genome unedited -- that is the point of it -- so the genotype layer is the one layer whose answer is arguably right, and it is right by accident: it was asked about the donor.

mesh.why: no surface mesh. A xenobot is the one subject in runs/ whose shape is genuinely designed rather than inherited, and it is the one this repository has no builder for: anatomy-model/parametric is a parametric teleost builder.

what_it_taught: The document can now say what the subject IS. Handed a construct, every layer that wanted a taxon used to take the donor's and carry on -- not a wrong clade, a wrong KIND of thing. With made_from stated, the phenotype reference set refuses as a construct and names what IS answerable (the genome is the donor's, unedited), and the donor hierarchy is labelled as the donor's rather than presented as the subject's.
